paragraphs: Minyamin bar Ihi. (Minyamin the priest, Nehemiah chapter 12, verse 41). See the entry Avuha bar Ihi.[^1]

notes.text: The parenthesis supplies the biblical Minyamin the priest and Nehemiah פ״יב־מא, read as chapter 12 verse 41, without independent named-edition verification. The cross-reference points to the separate Avuha bar Ihi entry. The shared name material does not merge the biblical example with the heading figure. No personal rabbinic title is supplied; priest is the explicit parenthetical designation.
